title: Request file
description: The request of a held write or a revert, handed beside a hash link (<base>/approvals/<approvalId>#h=<h> or <base>/reverts/<revertId>#h=<h>) when no short link exists and the long link is over the link budget. The agent sends the person a file named fileName holding exactly text, or, when it cannot send files, each of blocks as a message of its own. h is base64url without padding of the first 16 bytes of sha256(utf8(text)): a transfer check, not a trust anchor. See CONTRACT.md, The request file and pasted blocks.

fileName.description: basalt-approval-<approvalId>.txt or basalt-revert-<revertId>.txt; planned, basalt-plugin-<approvalId>.txt for a plugin approval.

text.description: The request text: the long link's fragment without its #, 2.<request> (CONTRACT.md, Format 2). The whole content of the file, with no line break at its end.

path.description: Set by basalt mcp, never by the engine: the absolute path of a file on the agent's machine that holds exactly text (mode 0600, the agent's OS user), under <user cache dir>/basalt/requests/, named fileName. The agent attaches it instead of copying text. Absent when basalt mcp could not write it.

blocks.description: text cut into consecutive pieces of exactly 1800 characters (the last 1 to 1800), in order: block i of n is the line basalt-request <i>/<n> <h> <length> (the piece's length), a line break and the piece. Present when n is at most 10; absent above, when the request goes as a file only.
